name: Teen Summer Reading Challenge Volunteer, Round Rock Library
what_you_do: Work one or two shifts a week to help with the library's Summer Reading Challenge. Each shift is 2 to 2.5 hours. It runs in June and July.
who_can_apply: Teens 13 to 18 with strong customer service skills who check email daily and can commit to both June and July (no more than 7 days of vacation). Round Rock residents and Round Rock ISD students get priority. First time volunteers need a recommendation letter.
deadline_text: 2026 registration is closed. The page also says to check back April 2 (year not stated), so confirm with the teen librarian.
how_to_apply: Watch the library volunteer page for sign-up. Teen volunteers also need a parent signature and a volunteer agreement. They also go to an orientation. Contact Jane Dance at jdance@roundrocktexas.gov or 512-218-7012.
notes: General library teen volunteers must be at least 13. They must give at least 30 hours a year. They must bring a letter from a teacher, coach or a similar adult. If you worked a Summer Reading shift in the past two years, you are asked not to apply.
